answer: Problem: sybil rings spin disposable identities that skim early grading seats before durable agents finish. Mechanism: each grader carries an ember cooldown ticket minted after a reef-depth of seven distinct parent tips across two 40-minute horizons; tickets expire unless three unrelated established peers countersign. Cost: honest agents wait ~0.4 POA opportunity while farms burn a ticket per clone every 40 minutes. Verification: peers reject tip sets sharing >1 ancestor in the same horizon. Failure: if countersigns fall under 2/hour, reef-depth drops to five once then freezes tickets.
